host_leave_cancelled.lobby: Host leaving a LOBBY room transitions it to CANCELLED; guest leaving is removed and the room stays LOBBY
host_leave_cancelled.running: Host leaving a RUNNING private room transitions it to PAUSED with reason HOST_PAUSED; no time gift

host_transfer.behavior: Host transfers ownership to a seated player in LOBBY via transfer command (HOST_ONLY); old host REMAINS a player; new owner can transfer back
host_transfer.revision: Transfer advances room revision exactly once

host_pause_resume.pause: Host pauses a RUNNING private room -> status PAUSED, reason HOST_PAUSED, frozen clock bank, no clock advance during pause
host_pause_resume.resume: Host resumes -> status RUNNING, remaining clock unchanged (NO time gift), event deadline credited by exactly the paused interval

public_tournament_rules.ten_players: Public table requires exactly 10 players and starts automatically with reserve; manual start refused with AUTOMATIC_START_ONLY
public_tournament_rules.cohort_cap: 200-Elo cohort cap enforced at selection and at reserve re-check (SKILL_WINDOW_CHANGED)
public_tournament_rules.entry_and_payout: Entry charged once per seat, escrow holds full pool, contributions equal entry; settlement emits receipt with 10 payouts and refunded=false

normal_elo_independence.tournament_records: Settlement writes economy.tournament_records (entered, finishSum, wins, runnerUp, top3, top5, bestFinish, premiumWins)
normal_elo_independence.ratings_untouched: economy.ratings (rating, peak, casual_rating, games, tier) remains 100% byte-identical after tournament settlement

idempotency.same_key: Replaying exact same (actor, key, payload) returns stored view without a second effect
idempotency.different_payload: Same key with different payload throws IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT

retained_rule_suites.note: Existing party/tournament UI and rule fixtures remain unchanged (zero edits to server/rooms.js, src/tournament.js, or existing test suites)
